messages:
sam: hey team, spotted an odd micro-spike for customer 'aurora' on the token timeline — lots of small repeats in a ~1m window :confused:
dina: which view? service or per-request timeline?
sam: /console/customers/aurora/requests -> timeline view. multiple emits with the same tag/amount stacked close together.
ravi: raw logs look like resume retries causing ledger to accept duplicate emits. snippet:
```
2026-03-24T02:15:42Z router=canary-7 session=sess-77 resume_attempt=1 kv_tag=kt:0x1a op_id=resume-A
2026-03-24T02:15:43Z router=canary-7 session=sess-77 resume_attempt=2 kv_tag=kt:0x1a op_id=resume-B
2026-03-24T02:15:43Z ledger=lg-4 emit_credit customer=aurora amount=5 tag=kt:0x1a trace=tx-555
2026-03-24T02:15:43Z ledger=lg-4 emit_credit customer=aurora amount=5 tag=kt:0x1a trace=tx-556
```
mei: ledger deduping today is (session_id, op_id) so different op_id on retry -> double apply.
dina: product worry: customers see two invoice line items. can console collapse/aggregate adjacent emits so we don't unnecessarily alarm customers?
sam: short-term: console grouping is OK, but we need billing correctness. medium-term: make ledger idempotent on a producer-supplied nonce (resume_nonce) and reject duplicate nonces within TTL.
ravi: quick mitigations we can do now:
- pause the router canary
- run targeted reconcile to detect adjacent emits (<=1s) same tag & amount
- add alerting for adjacent-emit ratio spikes
Which order?
ops-bot: Deploy 2026-03-24T02:15:50Z router/canary -> 15%
ravi: pausing canary now. running reconcile query.
mei: i'll design resume_nonce header and ledger opt-in flag (config flag so older producers unaffected). TTL default 30s. low risk toggle.
dina: product will prototype UI grouping (collapse contiguous ledger events within 2s) and add a tooltip explaining grouping.
billing-bot: refund policy: automatic refund if <500 tokens, manual review otherwise.
ravi: reconcile query results: found 12 candidate duplicate emit groups in window -> ~60 tokens extra credited to aurora. below automatic threshold. issuing refund. refund id ref-20260324-09.
sam: agreed owners: eng-runtime (mei) for nonce+ledger opt-in; eng-platform (ravi) for reconcile + rollout gating; product (dina) for UI grouping; billing (billing-bot) for refunds.
mei: I'll send PR today to wire resume_nonce from router and add ledger flag to honor it. also add unit tests for duplicate-nonce reject.
ravi: gating plan: keep rollout paused at 0% until canary sends resume_nonce and ledger opt-in is toggled in staging.
dina: will draft a short customer note for aurora explaining we found and refunded duplicate micro-charges, plus an FAQ blurb.
sam: can we also add alert rule: adjacent_duplicate_emit_ratio > 0.15 triggers page and includes last_deploy_id? that would speed detection next time.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: adjacent_duplicate_emit_ratio (threshold=0.15) -> webhook to #oncall + include deploy metadata.
ravi: reconcile job run id r-20260324-02 completed. refund tx posted.
mei: PR: github.com/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/842 (resume_nonce + ledger opt-in).
dina: thanks all. follow-up postmortem scheduled 2026-03-25 09:00 PT.
